verdict.rationale: The official gumloop/gumloop-py GitHub repo describes a self-contained installer under ~/.gumloop that ships its own Python and needs no sudo. That suggests a locally installed command-line tool, as does an 'Ask Gumloop Chew' decision-only invocation, but neither the docs nor the repo explicitly name or document a CLI. The Python and JavaScript SDKs and the API are developer building blocks and are not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a CLI and its commands, CLI auth and usage docs, and evidence of agent-oriented CLI workflows or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The installer is fully self-contained under ~/.gumloop — it ships its own Python, never touches your system Python, and needs no sudo.
Ask Gumloop Chew which of your candidate models should handle a task. Decision only — nothing runs.
